steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: These are language models for asking for help. Listen for the symptom, the body part and the next question; the dialogue does not diagnose or recommend treatment.

steps.title: At the pharmacy
steps.body: Samira asks a pharmacist to explain a medication label.

examples.fr: Bonjour. J'ai mal à la gorge depuis hier.
examples.en: Samira: Hello. My throat has hurt since yesterday.
Pharmacienne: Hello. Do you have a prescription?
Samira: No. Can you explain this leaflet to me?

examples.fr: Oui. Je peux vous expliquer la notice et l'étiquette.
examples.en: Pharmacienne: Yes. I can explain the leaflet and the label to you.
Samira: Thank you. Can you explain the dose to me?

examples.fr: Bien sûr. Je vais vous expliquer.
examples.en: Pharmacienne: Of course. I will explain it to you.

steps.title: At the clinic reception
steps.body: Samira checks in for her appointment.

examples.fr: Bonjour, madame. Votre nom, s'il vous plaît ?
examples.en: Réceptionniste: Hello, ma'am. Your name, please?
Samira: Samira Haddad. I have an appointment.

examples.fr: Votre carte d'assurance maladie, s'il vous plaît.
examples.en: Réceptionniste: Your health insurance card, please.

examples.fr: Voici ma carte. J'ai mal à la tête depuis hier.
examples.en: Samira: Here is my card. My head has hurt since yesterday.

examples.fr: Merci. La salle d'attente est à droite.
examples.en: Réceptionniste: Thank you. The waiting room is on the right.

steps.prompt: What does Samira want the pharmacist to explain?
steps.explain: She asks about the notice and the dose shown on the label.

steps.prompt: What does the receptionist ask Samira to show?
steps.explain: The receptionist asks for her carte d'assurance maladie.

steps.prompt: How long has Samira's head hurt?
